name: Skeptic
reason: I'll grant that a cyano index of 0.312 rising 0.129 in a week with a perfect September bloom history is hard to wave off, but 26 C with zero hot days and almost no runoff isn't classic bloom fuel, and one satellite reading can be glint or noise.
evidence: cyano_index 0.312, up 0.129 vs last week: a real jump, but a single-pass reading with no confirmation
bloom_rate_this_month_past_years 1.0: strong prior, though it says nothing about this week's conditions
max_temp_avg 26.0 with hot_days 0: warm but not peak-heat conditions
rain_last_14d_mm 2.0 and heavy_rain_days 0: little nutrient input to explain rapid growth
